remarks:
Beautifully updated and tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in a highly desirable East Amherst neighborhood, within the sought-after Williamsville school district, 107 Waxwing Court offers 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and 2,400 sq. ft. of inviting living space. A bright living room flows into the formal dining room, while the eat-in kitchen overlooks the park-like backyard. Updated in 2026, the kitchen features quartz countertops, a new sink, cooktop and double ovens. The spacious family room is a standout, with vaulted ceilings, wood beams, a wood-burning fireplace with custom built-ins, and new plush carpeting. A private home office provides a versatile retreat to work from home or can be used as a den or playroom, while a convenient first-floor laundry room and a half bath complete the first floor.

Upstairs, the generous primary suite features a private bath with a tiled walk-in shower. Three additional spacious bedrooms offering ample closet space and share a beautifully updated full bath with an extra-wide soaking tub. Both the upstairs bathrooms feature custom Amish-made wood vanities with quartz countertops. The full basement includes all professional grade gym equipment and free weights!

Extensive improvements include high efficiency furnace and A/C (2014), roof (2018), laundry room and office remodels (2020), garage windows and door, exterior painting, and hot water tank (2024). Fresh interior paint, new custom blinds, kitchen updates, and family room carpeting complete the 2026 improvements.

An exceptional combination of space, thoughtful updates, and a sought-after location—don't miss this opportunity to make this home yours! Showings begin immediately. Open houses Saturday, October 10, and Sunday, October 11, from 1–3 PM. Seller reserves the right to set an offer deadline.
